question: Which of the following is an autobiography by Mahatma Gandhi?

options.text: The Story of My Experiments with Truth

solution:
The correct answer is __**The Story of My Experiments with Truth**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Story of My Experiments with Truth** is an autobiography by** Mahatma Gandhi**.
 
• The autobiography covers Gandhi's life from early childhood through to **1921**.
 
• It was **originally written in Gujarati** and later translated into English by **Mahadev Desai**.
 
• The book provides a **detailed account of Gandhi's personal life**, his spiritual journey, and his political struggles.
 
• It is considered one of the most important works that provide insight into Gandhi's thoughts, philosophies, and the principles of Satyagraha.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mahatma Gandhi**, also known as the **Father of the Nation in India**, played a crucial role in the Indian independence movement.
 
• He was a proponent of non-violence and led several non-violent resistance movements against British rule.
 
• Gandhi's philosophies and strategies have inspired numerous civil rights movements across the world.
 
• His autobiography is not just a recount of his life but also a source of inspiration for those who advocate for truth and non-violence.
